title: Deterministic single-artifact atomic handoff visibility regression
instructions: A integration/completeness test-only gate. At EXACT base SHA, add ONLY NEW part2/capital_flow/tests/test_atomic_handoff_visibility.py. Do not modify production code or existing tests. Write standalone module-level pytest functions only (no unittest.TestCase), no network, no private dependencies. Test public storage.atomic_write_json for the single JSON handoff artifact (use tmp_path / 'anata_latest.json'): first publish full payload A with two correlated generation markers and nested fields; then start one background thread writing full payload B. Monkeypatch storage.os.replace with a narrowly scoped wrapper for this exact destination only: when writer B reaches replace, signal threading.Event 'entered' and wait for release Event with bounded timeout; all other replaces delegate immediately. While B is paused, parse destination with json.loads and assert it is exactly complete A, never missing/truncated/mixed fields; release B in a finally block, join with bounded timeout, propagate background exceptions, parse again and assert exactly complete B. Assert no leaked *.tmp files after completion. Use deterministic event synchronization rather than sleep. Ensure timeout fails loudly and does not hang pytest. Test should not claim deployed production-reader acceptance or cross-file snapshot atomicity: this is ONLY public single-file publication contract. Keep exact existing files byte-for-byte unchanged; compile new test; run targeted pytest then full Capital Flow pytest; commit ONLY if both PASS and changed paths exactly the single new file. If tests fail, fail closed without commit. Do not edit automation/.github, main, private, queue/control/status, secrets, prediction/API orchestration, journals, Telegram, MT5, broker/execution or Railway. Return minimal structured result.
